cd /tmp/eve

# Replace FlightAggregateState.AVAILABLE/HELD/BOOKED with SeatStatus.* in flights command + query, and add import
python3 - <<'PY'
import re,io
files = [
 "flights/src/main/java/com/study/app/command/FlightAggregate.java",
 "flights/src/main/java/com/study/app/query/FlightProjector.java",
 "flights/src/main/java/com/study/app/query/FlightProjection.java",
]
for f in files:
    s=open(f).read()
    s=s.replace("FlightAggregateState.AVAILABLE","SeatStatus.AVAILABLE")
    s=s.replace("FlightAggregateState.HELD","SeatStatus.HELD")
    s=s.replace("FlightAggregateState.BOOKED","SeatStatus.BOOKED")
    # add import after package line if not present
    if "import com.study.app.domain.SeatStatus;" not in s:
        s=re.sub(r"(package [^\n]+;\n)", r"\1\nimport com.study.app.domain.SeatStatus;\n", s, count=1)
    open(f,"w").write(s)
    print("updated",f)
PY
